scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@j-auth/token-verifier && npm run build --workspace=@j-auth/server
scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && npm run build --workspace=@j-auth/token-verifier && npm run build --workspace=@j-auth/server && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages/token-verifier tests/server tests/integration deploy/gateway
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages/token-verifier tests/server tests/integration deploy/gateway *.config.ts eslint.config.mjs scripts/prepare-cloud-test-runtime.mjs scripts/run-integration.mjs
scripts.test:integration:db: npm run build:contracts && node scripts/run-integration.mjs tests/integration/database.test.ts
